tools.name: agent_access_status
tools.description: Identity, current entitlement, daily usage and access instructions; explains missing/refused subscriber tools.

tools.name: crypto_exit_check
tools.description: Compare four BTC sell sizes by rung/bracket. Withholds stale/future, uncovered or unconverted venues. Fees excluded; no trade clearance.

tools.name: crypto_funding_cost
tools.description: Caller-input perpetual funding, fees, net carry and linear break-even. Positive funding: longs pay shorts. Constant-rate scenario, not forecast.

tools.name: crypto_portfolio_stress
tools.description: Caller-input linear shocks for 20 exposures: P&L, equity, asset/venue concentration. Symbols are scenario labels. No liquidation/probability model.

tools.name: depth_episodes
tools.description: Realized BTC depth-collapse onset, trough, recovery under preregistered rules. Zero is distinct from missing. Subscriber exit_desk_full adds ETH.

tools.name: exit_cost
tools.description: BTC nearest-rung sell estimates, interpolated bid-depth bands; fees excluded, not executable. crypto_exit_check compares sizes/freshness.

tools.name: gold_cash_realisation
tools.description: Calculate gold sale proceeds and cash gates from caller inputs. Decimal strings: kg, fineness (0,1], USD/troy-oz bid, USD fees, currency/USD FX (USD=1). Use aware ISO clocks. Returns arithmetic and withheld-cash reasons; no fetch, storage, execution or verified balance.

tools.name: latest_article
tools.description: Read the latest published editorial: title, full text, URL, clock and quality receipt. No arguments. Missing text or failed receipt returns an error; no generated prose. Use liquidity_tiers for board data.

tools.name: liquidity_tiers
tools.description: Nine segment tiers, Seiche funding, measure counts and replay/withholding reasons. PARTIAL means missing history or unpassed replay, never calm.

tools.name: market_corpus_context
tools.description: Inspect corpus coverage, rights and clocks. Summary takes no pagination; other views return records/total/next_offset. Retrieval age is not observation freshness. Use liquidity_tiers for market readings.

tools.name: research_network
tools.description: Find cross-product source metadata, clocks, rights and next steps. Follow next_offset; unavailable flags retrieval, contract or size failure. Use market_corpus_context for local corpus counts. No shared score or authority.

tools.name: sealed_record
tools.description: Forward calls sealed/signed before outcomes: hits, misses, decided counts, ledger root. Report hits and misses together.

tools.name: trade_safety_exit_context
tools.description: Exact-rung BTC/USD observe/paper context: request hash, PIT source/rights, conversion, bid bands, six venue clocks, startup SHA. No live mode or clearance.

tools.name: unwind_watch
tools.description: Watched-filer headlines: effective positions, days-to-exit brackets, blind spots. No live execution model. unwind_stress has full scenario grids.

tools.name: venue_concentration
tools.description: BTC two-sided depth: HHI, effective/top venue and venue depth. Subscriber exit_desk_full adds ETH and venue failure.

tools.name: venue_price_reconciliation
tools.description: BTC/ETH consensus: depth/squared-half-spread weights, deepest-venue blindness, concentration, dislocations. Experimental; no execution authority.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: latest_article · Private data: market_corpus_context, sealed_record · Public sink: sealed_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: latest_article · Private data: market_corpus_context, sealed_record · Public sink: sealed_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
